naip_band_order: R, G, B, NIR (USGS 4-band convention; NIR band dropped)
naip_band_read_note: Pillow reads the 4-band GeoTIFF as mode RGBA; channels 0..2 are taken as R, G, B and channel 3 (NIR) is dropped. Spot-checked against the surface-ID NDVI convention (band1=Red, band4=NIR) used by bake_zion_surface_id_png.py.
nodata_policy: Source NAIP mosaic covers the full terrain box with no nodata samples observed; no nodata fill is performed. Input bytes are hash-gated via naip_input_sha256.

params.downsample: box-average via summed-area table (every source pixel contributes once)

reprojection_note: No reprojection in this bake: the NAIP mosaic at naip_input_path is already aligned to the surface-ID grid (5501x5701 @ 1 m, EPSG:32612) by bake_zion_surface_id_png.py. Dimensions are asserted at read time.
shader_sampling_note: Intended consumer: the unified terrain shader (visual-phase-research-dossier.md P2 'NAIP macro albedo + distance fade'). Sample at world UV = ((world_pos.x - bounds_utm[0]) / (bounds_utm[2] - bounds_utm[0]), (world_pos.y - bounds_utm[1]) / (bounds_utm[3] - bounds_utm[1])); the texture spans the full bounds_utm extent. Use as a gentle MULTIPLICATIVE albedo modulator blended over the surface-ID base palette, NOT as the primary albedo: residual mid-day directional lighting is only partially removed by the desaturation + global brightness normalization, so a strong blend would re-introduce baked shading.
source: USGS The National Map USGSNAIPImagery ImageServer
